rules: One helper per source collection. A second helper for the same collection is never listed.
interface 'v3' entries are read through get-twin-interface. interface 'v1' entries are the three helpers live before the grant (built with Rapha / Fak.fun) and are read through their own getters.
A collection with no helper has status 'planned', 'screening' or 'manifest-review'. It is shown, but no action buttons are offered and no tool is linked.
legacyPage, when present, is the original hand-built page. It keeps working and stays linked from the shared page.
Counts and coverage are read live from the helper. The 'coverage' block holds only dated snapshots for evidence and must never be presented as live.

communities.name: Fak.fun collections
communities.blurb: The first three Forever Twins collections, built together with Fak.fun.

communities.name: NYC DGENs
communities.blurb: The NYC DGENs community page for the NYC Degens collection. The record is finalised: anyone can fund a twin, and holders can swap whenever they like.

communities.name: Megapont Ape Club
communities.blurb: The Megapont Ape Club community page. The record is finalised: anyone can fund a twin, and holders can swap whenever they like.

communities.name: Bitcoin Monkeys
communities.blurb: The Bitcoin Monkeys community page. The Forever Twins helper is not deployed yet, so there is nothing to inscribe or swap until its record is finalised. Many Bitcoin Monkeys files are larger than a single transaction, so this collection will use the large-file route.

collections.name: Bitcoin Pepes
collections.blurb: The first public Forever Twins collection. Holders give their Pepe a permanent on-chain twin, claimable on Fak.fun.

collections.name: LEO Cats
collections.blurb: LEO Cats holders can create a permanent on-chain counterpart backed by Xtrata.

collections.name: Miami Degens
collections.blurb: Miami Degens holders can create a permanent Xtrata twin, then swap which side stays liquid.

collections.name: NYC Degens
collections.blurb: NYC Degens holders can give their Degen a permanent on-chain twin, or swap which side stays liquid. The first collection built with the Forever Twins helper, deployed and finalised from the Xtrata wallet.

collections.name: Megapont Ape Club
collections.blurb: Megapont Ape Club holders can give their Ape a permanent on-chain twin, or swap which side stays liquid. Deployed and finalised from the Xtrata wallet: all 2,500 canonical records are sealed on-chain, and anyone can fund a twin.

collections.name: Bitcoin Monkeys
collections.blurb: 2,500 Bitcoin Monkeys. Helper not yet deployed. About one in nine files is larger than one transaction, so those twins will be created with the large-file route.

collections.name: See Yourself Out
collections.blurb: Cohort 3 for Milestone 1. Helper not yet deployed.
